attchmntText: Inox Green Energy Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Inox Green Energy Services Limited has filed the audio recording of a conference call with investors and analysts held on 13th November, 2026. The call took place subsequent to the submission of standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The company provided a link to the audio file for regulatory compliance under SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Regulations. The filing was submitted by Company Secretary Anup Kumar Jain on 14th November, 2026.

attchmntText: Inox Green Energy Services Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Inox Green Energy Services Limited filed statements of nil deviation regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Preferential Issue and Qualified Institutions Placement for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Audit Committee reviewed these statements on 13th November 2026. For the Preferential Issue of Equity Shares and Warrants, proceeds were utilized in accordance with stated objects, with no deviation reported. Total consideration received was Rs. 966.30 Crore. For the Qualified Institutions Placement, proceeds remained unutilized as at 30th September 2026 and were held in the designated QIP Escrow Account. The QIP was raised on 29th September 2026, aggregating to approximately Rs. 299,99,99,852.45. No deviation or variation was noted for either issue. The monitoring agency for both issues is CARE Ratings Limited.

attchmntText: Inox Green Energy Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Inox Green Energy Services Limited filed an earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. For Q2 FY27, total income was Rs 113 crores, up 12% quarter on quarter. EBITDA stood at Rs 62.5 crores, up 10% quarter on quarter. Profit before tax was Rs 58 crores, up 7% quarter on quarter. Profit after tax was Rs 44 crores, up 7% quarter on quarter. Cash PAT was Rs 58 crores, up 6% quarter on quarter. Machine availability was 96.2%. The portfolio stood at approximately 12.5 GWp as of September 2026. The company completed payment for the transfer of Wind World India’s 4.5 GW Wind O&M business. Financial consolidation of this acquisition is expected from Q3 FY27. The presentation was uploaded to the company website.

attchmntText: Inox Green Energy Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Inox Green Energy Services Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, approved by the Board on 13th November 2026. The company posted a profit after tax of 5,037 Lakh for the quarter and 6,582 Lakh for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 1.25 for the quarter and 1.64 for the half year. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved the grant of 79,373 stock options under the Inox Green Employee Stock Option Scheme 2024 to eligible employees. Statutory auditors Dewan P N Chopra & Co issued limited review reports. The auditors noted investments in six special purpose vehicles and revenue recognition policies for operations and maintenance services amounting to 11,857 Lakh. The company operates in a single business segment providing operations and maintenance services for wind turbine generators in India.
